description: This file defines the 'Preg' class within the Composer\Pcre namespace, providing a high-level wrapper around PHP's preg_* functions with additional error handling, strict matching methods, and utility functions specific to PCRE regex operations for the composer project.

classes.name: Preg
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for regular expression operations with enhanced error handling and additional functionality for the composer project.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs regex pattern matching on a string, setting matches by reference, with error handling.

methods.name: matchStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs regex match ensuring all groups are matched non-null, throws if any are unmatched.

methods.name: matchWithOffsets
methods.description: Performs regex match with offset capture, with error handling.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Performs regex match all operation, setting matches with null support, with error handling.

methods.name: matchAllStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs match all with strict non-null groups, throws if any are unmatched.

methods.name: matchAllWithOffsets
methods.description: Performs match all with offset capture, with error handling.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs regex replacement with error handling.

methods.name: replaceCallback
methods.description: Performs regex replacement with callback, with error handling.

methods.name: replaceCallbackStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs callback-based replacement with strict group null checks.

methods.name: replaceCallbackArray
methods.description: Performs multiple callback replacements with error handling.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits string based on regex pattern, with error handling.

methods.name: splitWithOffsets
methods.description: Splits string with offset capture, with error handling.

methods.name: grep
methods.description: Filters array elements by regex pattern, with error handling.

methods.name: isMatch
methods.description: Checks if pattern matches string, returning boolean.

methods.name: isMatchStrictGroups
methods.description: Checks match with strict non-null groups, returning boolean.

methods.name: isMatchAll
methods.description: Checks if all pattern matches, returning boolean.

methods.name: isMatchAllStrictGroups
methods.description: Checks all matches with strict non-null groups, returning boolean.

methods.name: isMatchWithOffsets
methods.description: Checks match with offsets, returning boolean.

methods.name: isMatchAllWithOffsets
methods.description: Checks all matches with offsets, returning boolean.
